summary: Two implementation defects block task 7. The file server does not read the checked real path. The Kimi reason limit counts bytes, not characters. One unresolved historical SHA also remains.
blocking_findings: RA3-01 (high): checkedModelFile and the stage branch return candidate, not real (book-pictures.ts:2208,2253). serveBookFiles then reads that unchecked pathname. A path can change after realpathSync and expose another file. This violates contract.md:285-287 and test-strategy.md:354-356. T78 checks static symlinks only. Return the checked real path and add an in-root symlink regression.

RA3-02 (medium): precheckKimi rejects reasons over 500 UTF-8 bytes (book-pictures.ts:3457). Contract.md:292 and T83 set a 500-character limit. A reason with 300 non-ASCII characters can fail. T83 uses ASCII only. Enforce the character limit and add a multibyte boundary case.

RA3-03 (low, provenance): Green log line 71 still contains full SHA 245f8c1a5a94a96c88553a70a46684a53956b59e. git rev-parse returns 128 for it. Therefore not every full SHA in the required artifacts resolves. Shorten this historical quotation and keep the corrected full SHA on line 72.
nonblocking_findings: RA3-N1 (low): metadata.json actual_tasks remains 6 while plan.md marks seven Phase 2 tasks complete. Green updated estimated_tasks only. Refresh the managed completion facts during closeout.
